company_info.company_description: "We do not use sub-contractors, with all of our installations carried out by our own in house electricians. We are licensed electrical contractors, which means that we can and do employ our own teams of installers to carry out the work.The whole process is carried out in house from a site visit to explain how Solar PV will work for you right through to completion of the solar system installation as well as a post installation follow up service.We have carried out many thousands of solar PV installations, which is why we really understand it.We supply solar PV systems that are grid connected and we also supply off grid solar systems with batteries for more remote situations."

Installation occurred on the two days nominated (unfortunately, they arrived four panels short but were back within a week to install the shortfall). Installers were polite, friendly and worked unobtrusively and fast. After a short period with the power turned off, everything was brought online and reconnected with a fully operational system. Email arrived almost immediately to advise how to download the app required to monitor the solar panels, battery and link with grid.

I was impressed by the thoroughness of their workmanship and the many testing procedures that were needed to commission the product.They left my garage area spotless.If these employees are representative of the staff quality at Ahlec, the company is indeed fortunate to have such capable staff.I would have no hesitation in recommending Ahlec for anyone else considering the installation of a solar battery,

My wife and I recently had a home solar/battery system installed by Ahlec. The whole process ran smoothly from start to finish. At the initial consultation Austin was very attentive to our needs and clearly explained the various options. We did not feel as if he was trying to sell us the biggest or most expensive system but rather that which suited our needs best. Once we decided to go with Ahlec we were kept informed of the progress at each step by Amy in the office. Despite less than perfect weather on the day of installation, Alex and his team of installers worked cheerfully and industriously to complete the job and Sam subsequently liaised well with our provider to complete the meter installation and configuration and grid connection. The system is now up and running as expected. Based on our experience, we can only praise the whole team and would wholeheartedly recommend Ahlec to anyone considering them for their own installation.

We were recommended to Ahlec by our property manager who has had solar installs done for a few properties on the Sunshine Coast.  Ahlec were prompt in quotes, offered great value for money and were amazing with the customer service for the installation.  An absolute breeze for us as landlords living away from the property.  The frequent updates from Amy, Sam and Andy as well as the honest advice was much appreciated and the 'extra mile' given was fantastic. The install is clean and tidy with extra thought given to the 'look' of the panel placement and the inverter placement - which was going to be a bit 'harder' but ultimately in the spot we wanted - future proofed for battery install at a later date. The salesperson was fast to respond, came to see the job location, provided a couple of quotes, he was willing to make changes and provided plenty of advice. All 3 companies were very good I am happy with them all. It was the praise my good & long term friends gave about this company that made me choose them. You will have to get back to me we have made the deal & the installation happens in about 4 weeks.

Ahlec, to my understanding, is a small, family run business who pride themselves on providing quality systems and service. They were recommended to me by a friend who'd needed a non-standard system design, and he felt they had done an excellent job. Indeed, they were the only local providers who could/would offer a solution.We wanted to extend our existing solar system by adding more panels and a battery. Austin, the sales and quotation manager, spent quite some time with us working out the optimal arrangement given what already existed, our usage, and the various roof spaces available. We went through quite a few possibilities and I know he went and discussed them further with a colleague. He was nothing but thorough and was more than happy and able to answer quite detailed questions both during the consultation and by phone and e-mail afterwards.Installation, which given the size of the job took two days, was professional, courteous and extremely tidy. Ahlec's installers went out of their way to arrange the battery and inverters to take up the least space in our garage. We have three-phase power so some thought was put into ensuring that the various circuits were put onto appropriate phases to minimise issues for potential draw from the grid. Every one we spoke to, Austin, Alex, Sam and Andy were happy to discuss all aspects of the installation and provide clear technical information, as well as enthusiastically discussing some of the tweaks they were trying on the systems installed in their own homes.The installers broke five tiles during the job (almost unavoidable as our tiles are incredibly fragile); they replaced these as well as five other broken tiles they found on the roof. They also relocated two whirly birds and appear to have done a good job. At the end of the day they gave a thorough explanation of what they had done as well as providing clear diagrams of any new wiring etc.Communication before and after installation was excellent. Post installation, we had a few problems with the connection between the Fronius inverters and the monitoring software. E-mails were answered promptly and issues were escalated to the correct person who responded quickly. Ahlec contacted Fronius and returned multiple times until everything worked perfectly.It is my understanding that the sales/quotation manager will revisit us three months after the installation to go over the performance of the system etc.I'm extremely happy with the service Ahlec provided, and can recommend them unreservedly. It has been an absolute pleasure dealing with them.The only thing I can fault them on? The base of the bollard to protect the battery isn't quite parallel to the garage wall. My OCD will get over it eventually...maybe.

Ahlec have been wonderful from start to finish.  The quotes were received in a timely fashion with a number of options provided on sizing and hardware suppliers.  After plenty of discussion with the very patient Ahlec Rep I went for the Sungrow hybrid inverter and battery set-up, mainly for continuity of hardware and supplier support located in Australia. The install team were brilliant - they turned up on the scheduled date and the whole system was up and running by the end of the day. Our search for a solar PV system installer took a few weeks as we obtained a number of quotes (five in total, all on-site visits) but was worth it being able to speak to and assess each of the installers and their proposed solutions.Their salesman, Austin, was punctual, courteous and very knowledgeable.
